backlog.title: Memory Architecture Design Decisions
backlog.description: Questions from memory team that need resolution
notes: ❓ NEEDS DECISION: Should we use metadata filtering for memories? (e.g., adapter, mood fields)
What's the SQLite schema for conversation threads? (Need: thread_id, message_id, role, content, adapter, mood, timestamp)
Should we implement memory pruning? (Delete old/irrelevant memories to keep DB fast)
Context window problem: TinyLlama only has 2048 tokens (~1500 words)
Token budget allocation across system prompt, RAG context, history, and output
- Orchestrator: No RAG, last 2-3 messages only, fast routing
- Persona (FOCUSED): Last 5 messages, top-3 RAG, short responses
- Persona (CREATIVE): Last 3 messages, top-5 RAG, long responses
- Persona (THINKING): Last 7 messages, top-5 RAG, step-by-step analysis
RAG integration flow: EMBED query → QUERY vector DB → RETRIEVE history → BUILD PROMPT → SEND TO MODEL → EMBED & STORE response
Cross-adapter learning: Orchestrator can see persona's past conversations for better routing over time
Implementation priority: 1) One persona adapter first, 2) Add mood filtering, 3) Add orchestrator passive storage, 4) Cross-adapter retrieval

now.title: Document Decisions Already Made
now.description: Record the architectural decisions we've already agreed on
decisions: ✅ DECIDED: Orchestrator will NOT use RAG - speed matters for routing
✅ DECIDED: Adapter weights are generated locally, NOT hosted in repo (see README)
✅ DECIDED: Single thread for Tomo (not multi-threaded conversations)
✅ DECIDED: Store story notes and contextual memories that might be useful to remember
✅ DECIDED: Implementation priority: Start with one persona adapter, then add mood filtering, then orchestrator passive storage, finally cross-adapter retrieval
